dedupe_keys.name: wind tunnel experiment of a micro wind farm model

description: KU Leuven and Johns Hopkins researchers publish simultaneous measurements from sixty instrumented porous disks within a one-hundred-disk wind-farm model. Zenodo supplies fifty-six HDF5 files, one per layout, free under CC BY-NC 4.0. Arrays contain reconstructed velocity in metres per second, disk coordinates normalised by the three-centimetre diameter, and the sampling frequency. Sixty channels cover twenty rows and three instrumented columns, with an extra uninstrumented column on each side. These records can calibrate array-interaction and power-fluctuation components in wind-farm simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this experiment. Porous disks approximate turbines, not reproducing rotor control or aeroelastic loads. Tunnel scaling and reconstruction uncertainty limit transfer to full-scale farms. Acquisition dates and numerical values were not checked. No HDF5 file was downloaded or supplied analysis example executed.
